# Influencer Discovery Agent

The Apify actor [`apify/influencer-discovery-agent`](https://apify.com/apify/influencer-discovery-agent) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.11**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Find perfect TikTok influencers using AI. Analyze engagement, brand alignment, and get collaboration recommendations. Describe your ideal creator and get the best matches for maximum ROI.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Profile $0.1 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/influencer-discovery-agent) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-influencer-discovery-agent@0.0.11#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      influencerDescription: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `usernames` | array |  |  | Usernames — Add one or multiple TikTok usernames you want to evaluate as influencers. |
| `influencerDescription` | string | yes |  | Influencer description — Explain what are you looking for on the influencer, his style of content and engagement capability. Our Agent will evaluate your candidate and give a brief reasoning on if the candidate aligns well with your expectation. |
| `generatedKeywords` | integer |  | `5` | Generated keywords — Number of keywords to be generated by the AI to perform the scrape on TikTok. (max: 5) |
| `profilesPerKeyword` | integer |  | `10` | Profile per keyword — Number of profiles to be scraped per generated keyword. (max: 10) |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
